finite_sample_space: Ordered 40-tuples of permutations of [N_g], with cardinality (N_g!)^40.
auxiliary_edges: Edge (i,u) joins L_u and R_{pi_i(u)}. Colours distinguish parallel edges. L and R are disjoint.
selector: Lexicographically first tuple, by concatenated permutation value lists, satisfying E and C.
E: For every vertex subset S with 1 <= |S| <= N_g, the multiplicity-counted crossing edge count exceeds 2*|S|.
C: All distinct coloured-edge-set cycles of lengths 2,...,g-1 are pairwise vertex-disjoint. A parallel pair is a length-two cycle.
deletion: For each such short cycle delete its least edge in lexicographic (colour,left index,right index) order; then forget colours.
claimed_output_properties: every nontrivial cut has more edges than vertices in its smaller shore
limitations: Deterministic exact selector, not an efficient implementation.
